national_news.title: 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) Begins in Goa
bullets: The 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) opened in Goa under the official theme 'Stories Without Borders', bringing together over 150 films from 86 countries.
Key highlights include 21 films from BRICS nations, special showcases from Russia and Spain, and significant representation from 52 women filmmakers and 62 debut directors.

Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant highlighted state measures to build a global film hub, including the Goa Film Shooting Act 2021, single-window clearance, and plans for a dedicated film city with VFX facilities.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Inaugurates First SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the 3-day First Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum at Purana Qila in New Delhi.
The forum celebrates the civilisational heritage of the SCO region—marking 25 years of SCO's establishment—under the theme rooted in 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam'.
Key exhibitions showcased included 'ASTITVA – The Essence of Our Existence' (exploring Delhi's history from 1200 BCE to 1200 CE) and the 18th-century 'Mahabharat Scroll Pavilion – Anant'.

national_news.title: Government Sanctions 1.75 Lakh Houses Under PMAY-Urban 2.0
bullets: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) sanctioned 1.75 lakh houses under PMAY-U 2.0 during the 11th CSMC meeting chaired by Secretary Satendra Singh, taking total sanctioned units past 24 lakh.
In-principle approvals were granted for 1.27 lakh houses in Andhra Pradesh and over 22,000 houses in Maharashtra.
Launched in September 2024, PMAY-U 2.0 aims to construct or purchase affordable pucca houses for 1 crore eligible EWS, LIG, and MIG urban families.

national_news.title: Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya Addresses 16th FICCI TURF-2026 Summit
bullets: Union Sports Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya addressed the 16th FICCI Global Summit on the Business of Sports (TURF-2026) in New Delhi.
The government announced an outlay of nearly ₹2,000 crore for a sports goods manufacturing scheme to establish India as a global manufacturing and innovation hub.
France participated as the partner country for the summit, signing an MoU to enhance bilateral cooperation in sports technology and athlete management.

national_news.title: India Defeats Malaysia 4-1 in Women's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy
bullets: The Indian women's hockey team registered a 4-1 victory over Malaysia in the Women's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.
Goals for India were scored by Khan Mumtaz, captain Salima Tete, Pooja Sahu, and Lalremsiami at the Barkheda Nathu International Sports Complex.
The six-nation tournament features teams from India, China, Malaysia, Thailand, Japan, and South Korea.

national_news.title: Union Commerce Minister Targets $1 Trillion Exports for FY 2026-27
bullets: Union Minister Piyush Goyal set a target of achieving $1 trillion in exports for Financial Year 2026-27 during the FICCI Annual General Meeting in New Delhi.
India recorded $480 billion in exports during the first six months of the current financial year, backed by expanded global market access of $70 trillion.
India has initiated talks for a Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA) or Free Trade Agreement (FTA) with Egypt while advancing negotiations on the India-EU FTA.

national_news.title: India Attracts $11.3 Billion FPI in Early November, Reaches $569 Billion Exports: CEA
bullets: Chief Economic Adviser Dr. V. Anantha Nageswaran announced that India recorded $11.3 billion in Foreign Portfolio Investment (FPI) inflows in the first 18 days of November, addressing the 65th WFE General Assembly.
India's combined exports of goods and services reached approximately $569 billion from April to October, achieving a growth rate of nearly 17% while maintaining around 7% real GDP growth.

The CEA highlighted that India operationalised trade agreements with the UK, Oman, and New Zealand this year, alongside lifting nearly 500 million people above the $4.20-a-day moderate poverty line in the last decade.

national_news.title: Solid Waste Management Rules 2026 Mandate Four-Way Segregation at Source
bullets: The Solid Waste Management Rules 2026 mandate source segregation of waste into four categories: wet, dry, sanitary, and special care waste.
The regulatory framework introduces enforcement mechanisms including mandatory online registration for bulk waste generators, user fees, spot fines, and environmental compensation.
The rules emphasize scientific waste processing, resource recovery, and remediation of legacy dumpsites, supported by initiatives such as a planned ₹361-crore integrated facility at Achan.

national_news.title: PIB Releases Daily Newsletter 'IFFILOID' for the 57th IFFI in Goa
bullets: Festival Director Ashutosh Gowariker launched the fifth edition of 'IFFILOID', the official daily newsletter for the 57th International Film Festival of India.
Published by the Press Information Bureau (PIB) under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, the bulletin is issued daily throughout the festival held in Goa from November 20 to 28, 2026.
The publication aligns with the theme 'Stories Without Borders', covering program schedules, screenings, filmmaker interactions, and event highlights.

national_news.title: PM Address at FICCI AGM Highlights Corporate Tax Reforms and Economic Growth
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI) Annual General Meeting at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.

The address highlighted key tax concessions including the reduction of basic corporate tax from 30% to 22% (under the Taxation Laws Amendment Ordinance, 2019) and personal income tax relief up to Rs 12 lakh.
Reiterated India's position as the world's fastest-growing major economy with projected growth around 7%, urging corporate leaders to boost domestic job creation and wage growth.

national_news.title: India's First Telecom Manufacturing Zone Established in Gwalior
bullets: Letters of Intent were distributed to 25 companies for land allotment in India's first dedicated Telecom Manufacturing Zone in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh.
The project is a joint venture between the Department of Telecommunications (49% stake) and the Madhya Pradesh government (51% stake), aligning with Make in India and Aatmanirbhar Bharat.
Phase-I covers 170 acres with Rs 3,600 crore investment commitment, while Phase-II will expand the manufacturing ecosystem by an additional 450 acres.

national_news.title: India Records $11.3 Billion FPI Inflows in November: Chief Economic Adviser
bullets: Chief Economic Adviser Dr. V. Anantha Nageswaran announced that India recorded $11.3 billion in foreign portfolio investment (FPI) inflows during the first 18 days of November.
India sustained a real GDP growth rate of roughly 7% and lifted approximately 500 million people above the $4.20-a-day moderate poverty line over the past decade.
Exports of goods and services reached $569 billion from April to October (a 17% growth), aided by recent free trade agreements with the UK, Oman, and New Zealand.

bihar_news.title: PM Modi Unveils Infrastructure Projects Worth ₹34,470 Crore in Bihar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched and laid foundation stones for multi-sectoral infrastructure projects worth ₹34,470 crore in Vaishali, Bihar.
Dedicated the 'Nitish Setu', a 19.7-km six-lane extradosed cable-stayed bridge over the Ganga River costing ₹4,280 crore, connecting Kachhi Dargah (Patna) with Bidupur (Vaishali).
Attended the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of IIT Kharagpur (established 1951) in West Bengal and the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

bihar_news.title: PM Modi Launches Development Initiatives Across West Bengal, Bihar, and Uttar Pradesh
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched multi-sectoral infrastructure and development projects worth ₹34,470 crore in Vaishali district, Bihar.
Participated in the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of IIT Kharagpur (West Bengal), India's first IIT founded in 1951 and designated as an Institute of National Importance.
Attended the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh at Lucknow, feliciting 52 national toppers from ITIs, NSTIs, and IToTs to promote skill development.

bihar_news.title: NTPC and NPCIL to Invest ₹1.4 Lakh Crore for Nuclear Power Plants in Bihar
bullets: State-owned NTPC Ltd and Nuclear Power Corporation of India Ltd (NPCIL) signed MoUs to set up two nuclear power plants of 2,800 MW capacity each in Bihar with an investment of ₹1.4 lakh crore.
NTPC will establish a 2,800 MW plant at Bhitiya in Banka district (₹70,000 crore), while NPCIL will develop a 2,800 MW plant at Talhar in Siwan district (₹70,000 crore).
The agreements are part of six energy projects worth ₹1,72,885 crore, which also include four pumped storage facilities, creating a combined capacity of 11,600 MW.

bihar_news.title: Prime Minister Dedicates ₹4,280 Crore 'Nitish Setu' Cable-Stayed Bridge in Bihar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi dedicated the 'Nitish Setu' over the River Ganga in Bihar, built at an estimated cost of around ₹4,280 crore.
The 19.7-km project comprises a 9.7-km main extradosed cable-stayed bridge and 10 km of approach roads, connecting Kachhi Dargah (NH-22, Patna) to Bidupur (NH-322, Vaishali).
The bridge will ease traffic congestion on Mahatma Gandhi Setu and JP Setu, reducing travel time between North and South Bihar as part of a wider ₹34,470 crore package.

bihar_news.title: Drip Capital Partners with Bihar Government for Rs 5,000 Crore MSME Trade Finance
bullets: Drip Capital signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Department of Industries, Government of Bihar, to facilitate up to Rs 5,000 crore in collateral-free trade finance over five years.
The working capital trade finance will support MSME exporters with fast disbursal within 24 to 48 hours, enabling small units without prior banking history to access credit.

Initial trade marketplaces will be launched in Darbhanga and Madhubani for makhana, Madhubani textiles, and handicrafts, partnering with JEEViKA and the Bihar Khadi Board to link over 100 producer groups and FPOs.

bihar_news.title: Adani Energy Solutions Wins Transmission Project for Pirpainti Power Plant in Bihar
bullets: Adani Energy Solutions Limited (AESL) won a transmission project via Tariff Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB) to evacuate power from the upcoming 2,400 MW (3x800 MW) Pirpainti Ultra Super Critical Thermal Power Plant in Bihar.
The project will be executed through a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV), Vikramshila Power Transmission Ltd., with delivery targeted by the fourth quarter of 2028.
It involves constructing 4 Gas Insulated Substations (GIS) at Jhanjharpur, Bethauli, and Begusarai, adding 881 circuit kilometres (ckm) of transmission lines and 3,160 MVA of transformation capacity.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves Scholarship Hikes for OBC/EBC and New Social Media Rules
bullets: Under the Mukhyamantri Pichchda Varg Evam Atyant Pichchda Varg Pre-Matric Chhatravritti Yojana, annual scholarship rates were revised to ₹1,200 (Classes 1–4), ₹2,400 (Classes 5–6), and ₹3,600 (Classes 7–10), with ₹1,751 crore sanctioned.
Approved the Bihar Government Servant Conduct (Amendment) Rules, 2026, making prior permission mandatory for government employees to create personal social media accounts.
The new rules prohibit public servants from posting workplace videos, sharing official policy opinions, live-streaming office communications, or using official credentials for personal profiles.
